hero.title: Help Center
hero.description: Find answers quickly, or get in touch with our support team.

faqs.question: How do I enrol in a course?
faqs.answer: Create a free account, open the course page and choose Enroll Now. For paid courses you can pay with bKash, Nagad, card or bank transfer.

faqs.question: Are online and offline certificates the same?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both lead to the same NYTI-certified certificate once you complete the training and pass the required assessment.

faqs.question: How can an employer verify my certificate?
faqs.answer: They can enter your certificate ID on the Verify Certificate page or scan the QR code printed on the certificate.

faqs.question: What if my certificate shows as expired?
faqs.answer: Some safety-critical occupational certificates must be renewed. Contact your training partner or NYTI to arrange a renewal assessment.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: Refunds are available within 7 days of enrolment if you have completed less than 20% of the course.

faqs.question: How does an institution become an authorized partner?
faqs.answer: Submit an application on the Become a Partner page. NYTI reviews documents, inspects the facility and then issues an authorization number.
